Container.Name: TasmoFleet
Container.Overview: Fleet manager for Tasmota devices: inventory and health, safe over-the-air firmware updates (image header and chip-family checks), configuration backups with restore, fleet policy rules, and a Prometheus metrics endpoint. Devices fetch firmware over plain HTTP from a dedicated port of this container. MQTT is optional; every feature also works over HTTP alone. Network ranges, MQTT, firmware sources, backups and single sign-on are configured in the web UI after the first sign-in. The first admin password is written to initial-admin-password in the appdata folder.

Config.Name: Web UI (HTTPS)
Config.Description: Web UI and API. Serves a self-signed certificate by default; put a reverse proxy in front for a trusted one (see the Trusted proxies variable).

Config.Name: Firmware server
Config.Description: Device-facing firmware server (plain HTTP; ESP8266 devices cannot use TLS). Tasmota devices download firmware from this port during an update. Choose any free host port that the devices can reach, and enter the resulting http://SERVER-IP:PORT/ URL as the firmware URL on the System settings page. Host port 80 is used by the Unraid web interface.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Database, secret.key, firmware cache and backups. Back it up as a whole: without secret.key the stored device passwords cannot be decrypted. The container runs as UID/GID 65532 (not nobody 99:100): run 'chown -R 65532:65532 /mnt/user/appdata/tasmofleet' once if the folder is not writable.

Config.Name: UI listen
Config.Description: Listener for UI and API inside the container. Must match the container port of the Web UI port mapping above.

Config.Name: Self-signed TLS
Config.Description: Serve a self-signed certificate on the UI listener. Set to false only when Trusted proxies is set (reverse proxy terminates TLS) and change UI listen to :8080 plus the container port of the Web UI mapping.

Config.Name: Firmware listen
Config.Description: Listener of the device-facing firmware server inside the container. Keep :80 to match the Firmware server port mapping.

Config.Name: Public URL
Config.Description: Only behind a reverse proxy or with single sign-on: external URL of the UI, e.g. https://tasmofleet.example.com. Used as OIDC redirect and logout target. Leave empty otherwise.

Config.Name: Trusted proxies
Config.Description: Only behind a reverse proxy: comma separated CIDRs of the proxy, e.g. 192.168.1.10/32. Forwarded headers and header authentication are trusted only from these peers. Leave empty otherwise.

Config.Name: Initial admin password
Config.Description: Password of the first local admin ('admin') on a fresh install; it must be changed at the first sign-in. Empty: a random one is written to initial-admin-password in the appdata folder.

Config.Name: Metrics token
Config.Description: Bearer token required on /metrics for remote Prometheus scrapers. Empty: only local scrapes are answered.

Config.Name: Log level
Config.Description: debug, info, warn or error. Leave empty to choose it on the settings page; a value here locks it. Logs are JSON on stdout.
